paragraphs.text:
“No!” shouts the distraught Charlie. “You do not understand! We 
must leave this valley at once! It is madness to stay!”

To accept defeat and go home, go to 32. To let the superstitious guide 
sulk in camp while you lead the others in a search, go to 52.
